name: Egyptian Kindergarten Curriculum (KG1/KG2)
description: Starter curriculum based on the framework commonly used in Egyptian early-years kindergartens (Nursery 2-3y, KG1 4-5y, KG2 5-6y). Placeholder content to drive the observation cascade; the founder's real curriculum (/home/nassef/Documents/replica/curri) can replace this file with no code changes.

milestones.name: Listens to a short story
milestones.description: Stays engaged and points to a character when asked.

milestones.name: Follows two-part spoken instructions
milestones.description: For example: 'put your cup down and wash your hands'.

milestones.name: Retells the main events of a story
milestones.description: Recounts a story heard in Arabic or English.

milestones.name: Answers comprehension questions
milestones.description: Responds to who/what/where questions about a read-aloud text.

milestones.name: Uses words and short phrases to ask for things
Speaks in full simple sentences
Describes a picture or event with new words
milestones.description: Uses vocabulary from stories, in Arabic and English.

milestones.name: Holds a short conversation clearly
milestones.description: Asks and answers questions and explains a simple idea.

milestones.name: Shows interest in books and print
milestones.description: Turns pages and looks at pictures.

milestones.name: Recognises own name in print
milestones.description: Finds the name card on the register.

milestones.name: Identifies letter sounds
milestones.description: Recognises Arabic letter sounds and/or English letters.

milestones.name: Blends sounds to read short words
milestones.description: Decodes simple CVC words in English and/or Arabic.

milestones.name: Makes controlled marks with crayons
Traces simple lines and shapes
Copies letters and numbers from a model
Writes own name and simple words
Counts objects to three

Adds and subtracts with objects up to ten
Matches identical shapes
Names circle, square and triangle
Sorts shapes by sides and corners
Combines shapes to build pictures
milestones.description: Creates models and pictures from shapes.

milestones.name: Sorts objects by one attribute
Continues a simple AB pattern
Creates own repeating patterns
milestones.description: Makes patterns with beads or shapes.

milestones.name: Predicts the next item in a pattern
Names and uses senses in play
milestones.description: Looks, touches, listens during discovery play.

milestones.name: Describes what things look, feel, sound like
Compares objects using senses
Runs a simple sense-based experiment
milestones.description: Predicts, tests and reports a result.

milestones.name: Points to common animals and plants
Names familiar animals and plant parts
Describes what animals need
Cares for a plant and explains its needs
Notices weather words
milestones.description: Sun, rain, wind at circle time.

milestones.name: Names the seasons and typical weather
milestones.description: Summer is hot, winter is cold.

milestones.name: Links seasons to clothes and play
Records daily weather on a chart
Says own name and names body parts
Talks about likes and dislikes
Describes own feelings with words
Reflects on what helps them learn
Plays alongside other children
milestones.description: Parallel play in the home corner.

milestones.name: Shares toys with encouragement
Takes turns and plays co-operatively
Resolves simple conflicts with words
Joins group activities with support
milestones.description: Sits with the group at circle time.

milestones.name: Follows simple classroom routines
Works with a partner on a task
milestones.description: Builds or completes a puzzle together.

milestones.name: Contributes to group projects
milestones.description: Takes a role and helps the class.

milestones.name: Walks steadily and climbs onto low furniture
milestones.description: Confident feet on and off equipment.

milestones.name: Runs, jumps and balances on one foot briefly
milestones.description: Moves with control around the room.

milestones.name: Catches, throws and bounces a ball
Runs, jumps, skips and climbs with control
Picks up small objects with pincer grip
Holds a crayon and makes marks
Uses scissors and threading with control
Holds a pencil correctly and forms letters
Washes hands with help
Eats with utensils and drinks without spilling
Uses the toilet independently

Draws a simple face and paints a picture
Draws people and scenes with detail
Plans and creates art, then talks about it

milestones.name: Sings simple songs with the group
Keeps a steady beat with instruments
Creates own rhythms and performs

milestones.name: Pretends with objects
